scope: 2-D private P2 feedback components only: actual GPU FS/C, force and optionally pressure/J update kernels. Not JSph::Run, physical free-body/periodic trajectory, dynamic Darcy, host configuration/restart, wall or public GPU acceptance.
execution_order: Default invocation runs only the predeclared10-force-call static components. Optional --integrate must be separately reviewed/admitted and adds independent64/128 prescribed-kinematics integrations; never auto-launch from a static pass.

required_API.force: StInterParmsg final arguments boundderivativevel,porotheta,const double*poroj. Nonnullporoj means feedback; null means old observer-only path.
required_API.FS: ComputeFreeSurfaceTracking final arguments marknearfs,const double*poroj. Actual C must use neighbourV0J, not old m/rhop.
required_API.update: Existing UpdatePorePressureSymplectic and UpdatePorosityObserver kernels unchanged; predictor receives already-halveddt,correctorfull dt.
required_API.not_yet_build_evidence: Authoring against agreed interfaces is not evidence that source implementation or authoritative builds have passed. Root must freeze/review/build actual production source before any component execution.

common.ledger: n=1-(1-n0)/J,V=V0J,rho_t=rhow+(rho0-rhow)/J; ledger CSV columns are explicitly independent references, not nonexistent GPU-internal diagnostic observations.
common.neighbours: Actual one-cell linked-list MakeDivDataGpu with empty boundary range and2 or9 fluid nodes. No replacement force/neighbour implementation.
common.old_density: Strictly positive Velrhop.w remains a legacy compute proxy, never claimed to be a complete variable-density outer-loop closure. Poison uses1000+37id; normal uses2100.

static_pair.geometry: Two dyadic nodes centered(.5,0,.5) with relative coordinates(+/- .0625,0,+/- .046875). Supply zero C for a raw-momentum test, not a singular FS matrix test.
static_pair.J: (.9,1.2) and reversed, each independently normal/poison;4actual force calls,4 node reference rows.
static_pair.stress_pressure: Unequal finite normal/XZ effective stresses and pore pressures2000/7000Pa; actual momentum reference uses float-converted stress and actual float raw kernel gradient.
static_pair.reference: a_i=Vj/rho_ti * [sigma_i+sigma_j-(p_i+p_j)I] gradW_ij; reversed receiver force usesVi/rho_tj. Require nonzeroX/Z references and unequalV/rho, original64FLT_EPS*max(1e-6,abs(reference))+1e-9 component budget; rho_t*V weighted net-forceL1<=64FLT_EPS*forceL1+1e-9.
static_pair.not_CPU_CSV_truth: Retained CPU momentum.csv records net force only, not per-node acceleration; no missing CPU fields are invented or filled.

static_FS9.geometry: 3x3 dyadic .25 grid centered(.5,0,.5), full-rank finite patch; all9 actualGPU correction matrices are rebuilt. This is not an infinite-domain or physical free-surface closure claim.
fields: dilation trace+1/32 plus symmetricXZshearA_xz=A_zx=1/64,spin0 and nonemptyXZstress
static_FS9.calls: Each field has actualFS+force normal and positive-rho-poison runs:6FS+6force calls,27 reference rows.
static_FS9.C_reference: Independent host2x2 full moment with neighbourV0J and actualfloat h/rr2/fac operands; explicit determinant inverse. Compare actualCxx/Cxz/Czz against inverse with64FLT_EPS*max(1,abs(reference)); no supplied scalar C or GPU matrix-solver bypass.
static_FS9.storage: abs(pdot+doubleKw/n_i*theta_reference)<=64FLT_EPS*abs(reference); receiverBmax/Bmin>1.1 proves heterogeneous local storage is nonempty.
static_FS9.stress: All six components checked against2G D+(K-2G/3)traceI at original64FLT_EPS*max(abs(reference),abs(Gtrace))+1e-6Pa/s. XY/YZ expected0, not an excited3-D shear claim. MixedXZrate must be nonzero and correct sign.
static_FS9.null_scope: Static nonuniform-J tests have nonzero trace. They are not called nonuniform trace-free shear/rotation tests.

poison.excluded_explicitly: Legacy raw density diagnostic ar may change; it is not a feedback-operator equivalence target. Physical input velocity/density, stored stress/pressure arrays must remain exactly equal to supplied inputs in each individual kernel evaluation.

optional_integration.initial: IndependentJ1,p0,sigma0,uniformrho2100,9node patch for every run; no PART or component state reuse.
fields: uniform-J-initial instantaneous rigid rotation on fixed reference patch
optional_integration.manufacturing: Prescribed float PosCell positions; affine velocity computed from actual storedfloat positions with dyadic rate. This avoids mixing ideal double positions and independently rounded velocities. Compression/dilation position stretch remains prescribed, not calculated by a mechanical integrator.
optional_integration.actual_updates: Each predictor copies actual deviceJn/pn, calls actualFS/force then existing pressure/J update CUDA kernels withdt/2; actualFS/force rebuilt at prescribed half geometry/currentJ, corrector CUDA kernels use originalJn/pn andfull dt. Host only supplies kinematics/references; never substitutes p/J recurrence outputs.
optional_integration.timing: 64stepsdt2^-16 and128stepsdt2^-17, commonend2^-10;65/129saved actual component times and all65 exact common pairs perfield, no interpolation.

gates_unchanged.reference: -Kw*log((actualJ-1+n0)/n0), a conditional storage reference, not exact general fluid mass

optional_integration.counts: Adds1536force+1536FS calls;total1546force/1542FS;6984history rows and260half-pair rows. No physical outer-loop step is executed.

remaining_gates: Actual private JSph host initialization negative-configuration guards are NOT exercised by this kernel-only fixture. A separate actual-host smoke/guard fixture remains needed; cannot claim CPU15guard equivalents.
